name: Akamai Aerial
imageAlt: Akamai Aerial website shown on a desktop display
body: When Akamai Aerial was ready to launch their new drone inspection business on Oahu, they needed a website that established trust, clearly explained their services, and helped generate leads from day one.

We built a modern, professional website that showcases their advanced drone capabilities — including thermal imaging, LiDAR mapping, and high-resolution aerial inspections for commercial buildings and infrastructure. The site was designed to look sharp, load fast, and rank well from the start. We also helped secure a strong domain name and ensured the site was set up for performance, security, and scalability from day one.

Akamai Aerial launched with a professional web presence that positions them as a trusted, FAA-certified drone inspection provider in Hawaii. They’re now well-equipped to serve commercial clients, contractors, and property managers across the island — with a website that works as hard as they do.
result: Traffic increased by 24% in the first 60 days.
